slides.headline: Zuckerberg asked "Alex, are you sure this is going to work?" before Meta's *$200 billion* AI bet

slides.heading: The *check*
paras: On the Cheeky Pint podcast, Zuckerberg recalled telling Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang that Meta would write a check for "$100 billion, $200 billion."
Then he asked: "Alex, are you sure this is going to work?"

slides.heading: Why he is *not worried*
paras: Zuckerberg argued the downside is smaller than it looks.

paras.t: "In order for it not to work out, it's not just that we have to fail, AI overall has to fail," he said.

slides.heading: *Gigawatt* clusters
paras: Meta's Prometheus cluster in Ohio is scaling beyond 1 gigawatt, and its Hyperion cluster in Louisiana is planned to reach 5 gigawatts, Benzinga reported.
Zuckerberg said the buildout will position Meta "to really lead in the area for decades to come."

slides.heading: A *rebuilt* team
paras: Zuckerberg said Meta was not happy with its trajectory after Llama 4. "We kind of like rebuilt the whole team," he said.
That team's new model is Muse Wonder, from Meta Superintelligence Labs.

slides.hook: Meta is betting up to $200 billion that AI pays off. Follow to see if it does.
